title: Comparison of Harmonic Scalpel and Ligasure Devices in Laparoscopic Morbid Obesity Surgery
brief_summary: Comparison of harmonic scalpel and ligasure devices in laparoscopic morbid obesity surgery especially in gastric bypass surgery patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* obesity
* BMI over 40 kg/m\^2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Normal BMI cases
